note: Global top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New' menu, notification counters, help, and user avatar controls
Project sidebar navigation -- renders: fixed section labels (Information, Repository, Issues, Merge requests, Pipelines, etc.); subtracts the project name header which is user-defined
Breadcrumb navigation -- renders: project path and section name (e.g., 'Issues'), which are structural identifiers for the current view
Issue list filter tabs -- renders: fixed state labels (Open, Closed, All) and counts
Issue list toolbar -- renders: 'New issue' button, search box, sort controls, and bulk update toggle; subtracts the tab bar, the issue list itself, and pagination
Pagination controls -- renders: 'Previous', 'Next', and page size dropdown
